8) The common barriers in innovating are:
   Internal barriers: People suffer due to high production costs, lack of funds and no support from communities. They either have to use their own money or they either just shut the business off. Because of many internal barriers, large amount of startups get bankrupt and gets shut down. Because they don't have people to support from the back.
   Fear: Fear of losing, getting bankrupt are very common when you start a business. But many people fear about it.
   Resource: Some people don't have enough resources or funding to support their ideas. Their idea might be excellent but without any resources, it is practically useless. People need resources for prototype, building, testing. Without resources it is not possible.
